revision.trigger: The regenerated protected contract corrected the ratified-vanilla classification of --pretty false.
revision.hypothesis: A dedicated separated-token family distinguishes preservation of Some(true) plus positional false from both invalid consumption as Some(false) and an artificial boolean-parser rejection.

classification_delta.regressions: none by construction; not dynamically executed

revision.cost: one artifact revision; zero product processes and zero corpus runs

authority.environment: shared workspace; authority constrained by the task allowlist
authority.attestation_claim: segregated oracle authorship only; no dynamic verdict

baseline.use: read-only intent oracle; whole-file byte equality is forbidden

decision_order: Classify as Unknown immediately when identity, parsing, extraction, normalization, timeout, size, capture, or budget is insufficient.
Otherwise classify as Violated when any mandatory assertion fails, recording the first stable public witness and reason_code.

unknown_policy.dynamic_action: stop the dynamic gate and do not seal

execution_safety.current_artifact_authorship: no product process, test, watch loop, or dynamic oracle was executed
execution_safety.capture: stdout and stderr must be separate bounded files
execution_safety.suite_scope: one focal crate or one focal test target per invocation; workspace-wide suite forbidden

fixture_catalog.requirements: No filesystem or command execution; compile, watch, and w are passed only to the in-process parser.
At least one profitable page content stream with visible text and operators, plus embedded font, raster image, ICC profile, metadata, and taggable formula; each artifact remains at most 4 MiB.
Text, quoted attribute containing >, nested group, geometry, paint order, reference graph, escaping, font, destination, and explicit fallback marker.

Document/head/block boundaries, adjacent phrasing nodes, title/raw text, void element, protected space, quoted attribute containing >, escaping-sensitive values, and both HtmlSerializationMode values.
Nontrivial alpha and color content with stable dimensions; decoded pixels are the normative comparison.

normalizers.pdf: Resolve Page /Contents with a bounded parser, decode only identified page streams, and compare parsed operator sequences and rendered morphology; never use whole-file bytes, object IDs, xref offsets, or line count.
normalizers.svg: Parse XML and discard only indentation-only nodes introduced between elements; compare the ordered tree and reference graph modulo consistent ID alpha-renaming.
normalizers.html: Parse HTML and discard only formatter-owned indentation nodes at declared structural boundaries; preserve all phrasing, title, raw, void, attribute, and protected-space semantics.
normalizers.png: Validate signature and compare dimensions, color model, alpha behavior, and decoded pixels; stable byte equality is a strong control only.

assertions: Each cartesian-product row parses successfully in process.
The raw parser state equals the listed tri-state before L4 resolution.
No watch or w subprocess is created.
Bare --pretty resolves Some(true); the following false token is not consumed as its boolean value.
False remains subject only to the command's existing positional grammar.
With the fixture's output positional unfilled, false occupies that positional.
The parser result is neither PRETTY_INVALID_BOOLEAN nor PRETTY_VALUE_REQUIRES_EQUALS.
Watch and w are observed only through Args::try_parse_from and no subprocess is created.
Only the selected PDF, SVG, or HTML encoder receives the resolved boolean.
PNG and compatibility wrappers remain semantically false.
Target, feature activation, HtmlSerializationMode, layout, diagnostics, and evaluated content do not change.
All four combinations compile and parse.
For fixed compact, toggling pretty changes page-stream FlateDecode only and preserves decoded operators.
For fixed pretty, toggling compact changes operator vocabulary only, preserves morphology, and retains the selected compression policy.
Tag structure markers follow PdfTags alone.
Page content-stream FlateDecode follows pretty alone.
All four combinations preserve decoded content and morphology.
Every Page /Contents stream obeys pretty's page-stream policy.
Font, image, ICC, and metadata streams retain their independently selected compression policies.
No resource stream is accepted as a substitute witness for a page content stream.
Absent and false use compact serialization.
True visibly adds two-space structural indentation.
After permitted whitespace normalization, ordered XML trees, reference graphs, attributes, semantic text, escapes, geometry, paint order, fonts, destinations, and fallback markers are equal.
Pretty adds whitespace only at structural document, block, and head-metadata boundaries.
No whitespace is inserted inside phrasing content, text, title, raw content, attribute values, void behavior, or protected spaces.
A > character within a quoted attribute never closes a tag for formatting.
Escaping remains selected solely by HtmlSerializationMode.
Normalized ordered DOM, attributes, and text semantics are equal.
All forms compile successfully to PNG with no pretty-dependent diagnostic or target change.
Signature, dimensions, color model, alpha behavior, and decoded pixel morphology are equal.
If the frozen encoder is byte-stable, all three SHA-256 values are equal as a strong non-normative control.

matrix.axis: eval, query, and info pretty domains
output target and HTML feature activation

assertions: Severity, channel, ordering, and exit class of unrelated diagnostics are unchanged.
Eval, query, and info retain their independent pre-existing pretty behavior.
Pretty does not select target or activate HTML.
Layout and evaluated content are invariant.

negative_cases.expected: Preserved when rejected as specified; a parser accepting any row is Violated
assertions: Each row is rejected by the in-process parser with exit-equivalent class 2.
The stderr-equivalent diagnostic identifies --pretty, the invalid or empty equals-form token, and the applicable boolean constraint.
Only the allowed diagnostic normalization is applied.
No watch or w subprocess is created.

opaque_cases.construction: A bounded PDF parser cannot uniquely resolve a Page /Contents reference to its stream owner.
The PDF is malformed or its page content stream cannot be parsed after supported decoding.
The SVG cannot be parsed as bounded XML.
The HTML parser cannot construct an unambiguous bounded DOM under the declared mode.
An SVG or HTML reference cannot be resolved or alpha-renaming cannot establish graph isomorphism.
A protected input, baseline identity, or artifact-to-case association is ambiguous.
Any required artifact is 4194305 bytes or larger.
An allowed compile process exceeds 20 seconds.
stdout or stderr capture is unbounded, truncated, merged ambiguously, or exceeds its declared bound.
The focal or full-corpus calibration budget is exhausted before a mandatory observable is established.

classification_vector_order: positive_cases in document order and each matrix in listed order
negative_cases by command order then spelling order
determinism: two identical-order runs after focal success produce the same vector
one reverse-order run produces the corresponding reversed vector
seal_blockers: any positive or required rejection not Preserved

limitations: This suite defines oracles but records no execution result.
It covers only the P1360 observable fragment and does not claim general equivalence with vanilla.
A verifier must independently validate hashes, effective capabilities, cases, mutations, and receipts before sealing.
